metadata.title: Dual Portrait with Torn Paper and Flame

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast macro portrait of a man's face, bisected vertically by a torn piece of paper. The left side shows the subject in sharp, detailed focus with visible skin texture and tattoos, while the right side (the paper) shows a softer, slightly out-of-focus version of the same face. A vertical flame licks up the torn edge of the paper, creating a glowing orange highlight.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp focus on the left eye versus soft focus on the right eye
Vertical division created by the jagged, white torn paper edge
Warm orange glow of the flame contrasting with cool, dark shadows
Macro skin texture juxtaposed against the flat surface of the paper
coreInvariants: Burning paper edge with visible flame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally but divided by the vertical tear. The face fills the entire frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp left eye and the bright vertical flame at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sharp left eye, follows the vertical flame downward, then moves to the softer right side of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space on the far left, providing a heavy shadow for the subject's profile.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the shadows and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the torn paper edge.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow of the vertical flame.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright flame/paper and the deep shadows; saturation is concentrated in the fire.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold sans-serif for utility and industrial feel.
graphicDevices: Rectangular border box for metadata text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, industrial feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides a clean, legible, and authoritative look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro portrait of a man with tattoos, split vertically. The left side is sharp and dark; the right side is a piece of torn paper showing a blurry version of the face. A flame burns along the vertical tear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small white rectangular box at the bottom center containing three lines of bold, condensed black sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the flame positioned exactly on the torn edge?
Is there a clear focus difference between the two halves?
Is the text box centered and legible?

adjustableVariables: Amount of blur on the right side
Density of tattoos on the subject
Width of the torn paper edge
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic interaction between flame and paper edge
Ensure the left eye is the sharpest point in the image
Verify the vertical division is not a straight line but a jagged tear
Confirm the color palette remains moody and dark
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Portrait + Vertical Torn Paper Overlay + Burning Edge + Chiaroscuro Lighting
